templates.name: Linux by Zabbix agent

items.note: (MemTotal - MemAvailable) / MemTotal, i.e. the MemAvailable-based used percent Slide already collects
per-filesystem total bytes from df; reserved capacity included by the canonical metric
per-filesystem used bytes from df; mount/device/fs_type stay dimensions

upstream.name: Host name of Zabbix agent running
Maximum number of open file descriptors
{#DEVNAME}: Disk read request avg waiting time (r_await)
{#DEVNAME}: Disk write request avg waiting time (w_await)
Linux: Getting closer to process limit
upstream.expression: last(/Linux by Zabbix agent/proc.num)/last(/Linux by Zabbix agent/kernel.maxproc)*100>80

upstream.name: Linux: High swap space usage
upstream.expression: max(/Linux by Zabbix agent/system.swap.size[,pfree],5m)<{$SWAP.PFREE.MIN.WARN} and last(/Linux by Zabbix agent/system.swap.size[,total])>0

upstream.name: Linux: Lack of available memory
upstream.expression: max(/Linux by Zabbix agent/vm.memory.size[available],5m)<{$MEMORY.AVAILABLE.MIN} and last(/Linux by Zabbix agent/vm.memory.size[total])>0

upstream.name: Linux: Load average is too high

raw Counter64 ifHCOutOctets; same counter-versus-rate note as the inbound item

upstream.name: Huawei VRP: Host has been restarted
upstream.expression: (last(/Huawei VRP by SNMP/system.hw.uptime[hrSystemUptime.0])>0 and last(/Huawei VRP by SNMP/system.hw.uptime[hrSystemUptime.0])<10m) or (last(/Huawei VRP by SNMP/system.hw.uptime[hrSystemUptime.0])=0 and last(/Huawei VRP by SNMP/system.net.uptime[sysUpTime.0])<10m)
